responsibility: Provides the top-level tree-vectorizer driver support and pass-level glue shared by loop vectorization, loop-aware SLP, and BB SLP. This file defines subsystem-global state such as vect_location, dump/cost reporting helpers, utility classes used by vectorization bookkeeping, and the IPA increase_alignment pass that raises alignment of eligible globals for better vectorization; it serves as the orchestration and common runtime support layer rather than the detailed loop, SLP, statement, or data-reference transformations themselves.
same_name_distinction: Contains the vectorizer subsystem's non-inline implementation and pass-driver glue declared around tree-vectorizer.h, such as global state, dump/cost reporting, helper method bodies, and the IPA increase_alignment pass; unlike the header, it is the executable orchestration layer rather than the shared type/interface definitions used across tree-vect-* files.
